results.title: Axed by CSK, Stephen Fleming Set To Replace Compatriot Brendon McCullum As England Test Coach: Report
results.description: Stephen Fleming is set to be named as the new head coach of the England Test team just days after he was removed from the role at Chennai Super Kings (CSK) after a 17-year tenure. The former New Zealand captain will replace compatriot Bredon McCullum.
